newsitem.title: BULGARIA: EUROPEAN INVESTMENT BANK TO FUND BULGARIA PROJECTS.
newsitem.headline: EUROPEAN INVESTMENT BANK TO FUND BULGARIA PROJECTS.

text.p: The European Investment Bank (EIB) is expected to fund the long-delayed reconstruction of Sofia airport and two main roads, Bulgaria's government press centre said on Friday.
A statement said interim Prime Minister Stefan Sofianski had met an EIB mission in Sofia to review EIB projects in Bulgaria.

"It was agreed that joint work will begin in financing the reconstruction of the Sofia airport and the highways from Sofia to Svilengrad (on the Turkish border) and from Sofia to (the Black Sea port of) Varna," the statement said.
Million-dollar reconstruction work, which will not interrupt the airport's operation, includes enlargement of the passenger terminals and lengthening the runway.

"Despite some delayed payments on the Bulgarian side, EIB representatives declared that they will stay in Bulgaria and will continue transfers under investment loans granted in the fields of energy, the road network and telecommunications," the statement said. -- Liliana Semerdjieva, Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-84561
